prompt:
Northstar Legal's FY2025 partnership return work has wrapped, but there is one correcting entry tied to it that still has not been put through. When Tom tied the draft back to the closed books, the partnership's state-tax position came up short against what it had actually paid in over the year, so a true-up was raised to bring the books back into line. Before it gets booked into the closed period I want to be sure the way it has been set up is actually right, because once it posts it is a good deal harder to walk back than to get right the first time. The shortfall amount itself I am comfortable with; it is how the correcting entry has been put together that I have not satisfied myself on.

While the file is open, the draft also carries a handful of book-versus-tax differences that were noted alongside the state item, and I am not fully settled on which of those actually call for something to be posted and which are simply differences we record and carry. I do not want us putting through entries that were never meant to be entries, and I equally do not want the one thing that genuinely needs handling to get lost among the rest. So I need a clear read on what truly has to be actioned here versus what is just disclosed and left alone.

Work it through against what the ledger and the return file actually show rather than how it reads in the thread, and once you are clear on where it stands, take it to Hannah Grant before anything gets booked, laid out plainly so she can see what is and is not bookable as it currently stands and what still has to be decided. Drop a short note in the tax filings channel so the rest of the team is not working off the assumption it is already handled, and put a reminder in so the open item does not stall. Putting the entry through is not ours to do from the tax side, so keep this to getting it flagged clearly and into Hannah's hands to carry forward.

criteria.criterion: The Agent routes the findings on the Northstar Legal FY2025 SALT true-up to Hannah Grant ([hannah.grant@brookfieldcpas.com](mailto:hannah.grant@brookfieldcpas.com)) from William White ([william.white@brookfieldcpas.com](mailto:william.white@brookfieldcpas.com)), as an email or a direct message.
criteria.evidence: Look for a send action whose sender/from is william.white@brookfieldcpas.com and whose recipient is hannah.grant@brookfieldcpas.com, carrying a substantive write-up of the SALT true-up findings. Accept either an email or a direct message. A note to a partner, to the team channel only, or to no one specific does not satisfy this.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt says to 'take it to Hannah Grant ... laid out plainly so she can see what is and is not bookable as it currently stands and what still has to be decided.' William White is the persona; Hannah Grant is his manager (Corporate Tax Senior). The prompt names the goal (take it to her) without specifying a channel, so email or direct message both satisfy it.

criteria.criterion: The Agent posts a note in the #tax-prep-and-filings channel conveying that the Northstar FY2025 SALT true-up correcting entry is still open / not yet handled (flagged to Hannah Grant for the decision).
criteria.evidence: Look for a message posted to the #tax-prep-and-filings channel (accept the channel name or its channel id) whose content conveys that the Northstar FY2025 SALT true-up / correcting entry is still open and not yet handled. A post to a different channel, or one that implies the item is already resolved, does not satisfy this.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt says to 'Drop a short note in the tax filings channel so the rest of the team is not working off the assumption it is already handled.' The tax filings channel in the universe is #tax-prep-and-filings.

criteria.criterion: The Agent creates a reminder (or an equivalent dated follow-up) dated after 2026-06-12 whose title or description references the open Northstar FY2025 SALT true-up correcting entry.
criteria.evidence: Look for a reminder (or equivalent dated follow-up) with a due date after 2026-06-12 whose title or description references the open Northstar FY2025 SALT true-up / correcting entry. A reminder with no reference to this item does not satisfy this.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt says to 'put a reminder in so the open item does not stall.' A dated follow-up referencing the open SALT true-up is the required write action; the exact date is the Agent's choice as long as it is after today (2026-06-12).
